name: Te, scho lyshajet'sja
source:
Shall we go caroling, dear guest? To a village where no one will remember your face, but they will remember every sound.

Here, silence, whispers and words sound equally loud. They save destinies, condemn to madness and lead to irreparable disasters.

Choose very carefully what you say and what you hear. From the first choice, you create a unique story.

[Translated from [url=https://chichka.itch.io/tsl]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
亲爱的客人，我们要唱颂歌吗？去一个没有人会记住你的脸，但他们会记住每一个声音的村庄。

在这里，寂静、低语和话语听起来同样响亮。他们拯救命运，注定疯狂，并导致无法挽回的灾难。

非常仔细地选择你所说的和你听到的。从第一个选择开始，你就创造了一个独特的故事。

[译自[url=https://chichka.itch.io/tsl]itch.io[/url]]
